decision: Build Job Posting Reality Score in a NEW repository, not by extending or forking Company Fit Radar (job-searcher). Extract only genuinely portable CFR pieces (Bedrock client wrapper reuse-unchanged; config/settings pattern adapt-behind-interface; staged-pipeline shape and dossier-render pattern as reference). See REPO_REUSE_AND_MIGRATION_DECISION.md.
decision_trigger: If the portable surface turns out larger than the Bedrock wrapper + config pattern, revisit fork-vs-new; if CFR is being actively co-developed and shares a release cadence, reconsider monorepo
dissent_or_alternative: Extend job-searcher in place (rejected: no tests, one-time/offline/local assumptions, orthogonal company-matchmaking domain, muddies public presentation). Fork (rejected: carries CFR git history and dead code).

decision: Greenhouse only, 3 operator-curated companies (all on Greenhouse) for V1 learning scale, 1 daily run. Ashby gated (ADR row below); Lever second.
decision_trigger: Spine trusted end-to-end and Brett wants real coverage -> add Lever + grow to 10-20 companies (useful scale). Adding companies/providers is config, not architecture.
dissent_or_alternative: Start multi-provider (rejected: Greenhouse has strongest identity + updated_at; learn where identity is easiest).

decision: Single account, single region us-east-1 (operator baseline; Bedrock Haiku/Sonnet available; billing metrics publish here).
decision_trigger: Second region needed for DR, or a required service unavailable in us-east-1, or account starts hosting unrelated prod -> split.
dissent_or_alternative: Multi-region (rejected: no DR need at personal scale).

decision: All resources prefixed jprs-. Cost-allocation tags on every resource: Project=jprs, Env=<stage>, ManagedBy=<manual|iac>. Record resource NAMES + console URLs, never account IDs or full ARNs.
decision_trigger: New environment (e.g. iac stage alongside manual) -> Env tag distinguishes; cost attribution gap -> add tag.
dissent_or_alternative: None material.

decision: Step Functions STANDARD (not Express) as the orchestration + audit surface. Owns report-assembly: Map over companies, Retry (transient) / Catch (States.ALL -> report_incomplete), 90-day queryable execution history (recall + audit value, phase P5).
decision_trigger: Run becomes high-frequency (many/hour), always completes <5min, needs no persisted history, and per-transition cost becomes material -> reconsider Express. None currently true.
dissent_or_alternative: Express (rejected: 5-min cap, no persisted history, at-least-once dupes). Plain SQS fan-out with no SFN (rejected: loses execution-history recall + Catch isolation).

decision: TWO SCHEDULES: schedule 1 (collect) fires enumerate -> writes RUN_OPEN manifest -> SQS fan-out, collectors drain async; schedule 2 (assemble, fired at a fixed offset later) runs the SFN Standard assembler which evaluates completeness against the settled queue + SUCCESS sentinels, diffs, and reports. Both keep SFN Standard (assembler side). Completeness judged by manifest-expected vs SUCCESS-sentinel-observed, never by wall-clock.
owner: Analyst (default) / reliability + architecture seats co-own the switch
decision_trigger: Switch to a SINGLE SFN execution with a Choice+Wait DrainBarrier (architecture seat's design) when: the fixed offset becomes unreliable (collectors regularly unfinished by assembly time), OR cadence goes sub-daily (fixed offset brittle), OR a single-execution audit unit is wanted. At that trigger, fold collection into the same SFN execution.
dissent_or_alternative: Architecture seat: single SFN execution, Choice+Wait barrier, 90s poll (deferred, not rejected — it is the named upgrade path).

decision: SQS Standard collect-queue + collect-dlq. One message per company: {run_id, provider, board_token, company_id}. Grain = one company because the diff needs a company's whole listing set and per-company isolation is the required failure boundary. DLQ is the physical embodiment of "failed fetch != mass removal."
decision_trigger: At <~20 reliable companies you MAY collapse to an SFN inline Map direct-invoke if you accept losing the DLQ quarantine + the SQS recall drill (the drill is in scope, so keep SQS in V1). Per-job grain too fine (can't diff a set); per-provider too coarse.
dissent_or_alternative: SFN Map direct-invoke, no SQS (deferred alt).

decision: S3-only. Single bucket, versioning OFF, prefix-partitioned, lifecycle-managed. No DynamoDB in V1.
decision_trigger: Introduce DynamoDB ONLY when: (a) concurrent writers touch the same current-state item needing atomic/conditional writes, OR (b) the historical layer needs indexed low-latency point/range queries too costly on Athena, OR (c) per-job mutable status (applied/interviewing/outcome) needing conditional writes.
dissent_or_alternative: DynamoDB now (rejected: one writer/company/run, whole-file read/write, batch analytics -> S3 cheaper + simpler).

decision: job_id = "{provider}:{board_token}#{provider_key}". Greenhouse provider_key = native id (+store internal_job_id, requisition_id); Lever = native UUID; Ashby = URL-slug UUID else content-hash (flag IDENTITY_LOW_CONFIDENCE). id_kind stored on every record. content_hash over canonical field set drives change detection independent of provider timestamps.
decision_trigger: New ATS dimension (per-department boards) -> extend tuple; Ashby content-hash collisions observed -> tighten canonical field set.
dissent_or_alternative: None (per-ATS capability-driven).

decision: disappeared fires ONLY when current snapshot.status==SUCCESS and job was in the most-recent-SUCCESS prior snapshot but absent now, past grace. Grace = 2 consecutive SUCCESS snapshots (not calendar days). Mass-drop guard: drop to zero or >60% vs prior SUCCESS -> source SUSPECT, ALL removals suppressed + A6 fires. On FETCH_FAILED/PARTIAL: freeze all job states, pause grace, emit source-scoped event only. probable-repost when repost_score>=0.7 within 30d.
default: grace N=2 SUCCESS snapshots; mass-drop >60% or zero = SUSPECT
decision_trigger: False-disappearance rate observed >~5% -> tune grace; per-source volatility differs -> per-source mass-drop thresholds; any single mass-false-removal incident -> tighten full-drop guard.
dissent_or_alternative: None (reliability + data seats consistent).

decision: SES (SNS fallback) sends one daily digest to Brett as the last assembler state. Report is persisted to S3 (reports/dt=) regardless of send success. Report labels every company CHANGED / NO-CHANGE / NOT-COLLECTED and carries a run-health header VERIFIED-QUIET / INCOMPLETE(sources named) / (NO-RUN caught by alarm A2, not the report).
decision_trigger: Multiple downstream consumers of change events appear -> add SNS/EventBridge bus; Brett prefers pull -> read reports/ in S3, drop SES.
dissent_or_alternative: SNS-only (fallback if SES identity verification is friction).

decision: Six deterministic, individually-inspectable dimensions: brett_fit, freshness, hiring_activity_evidence, repost_churn_pattern, source_data_confidence, application_priority (composite). observed_application_outcome added later. Each emits {score, band HIGH/MED/LOW/UNKNOWN, confidence, evidence_refs[], version}. UNKNOWN first-class. Composite confidence = weakest-link (min). scoring_profile v1.0.0 weights versioned.
default: 6 deterministic dims, no opaque single score
decision_trigger: observed_application_outcome data exists -> recalibrate weights (profile v-next); too many/few surfaced jobs -> tune brett_fit floor (default 0.2).
dissent_or_alternative: Single blended reality score (rejected: not decomposable, invites fake/real reading).

decision: LLM is a NARRATOR, never authority. It narrates from supplied scores + evidence only; MAY NOT invent dates, decide disappearance/repost/real-fake, or compute any score. Deterministic post-check extracts dates/numbers from LLM output, rejects any not in the supplied evidence -> template fallback. Never-say-fake vocabulary banned by the report renderer. Every generated sentence cites a stored evidence id.
default: narrator-only, deterministic post-check, off in V1
decision_trigger: Narration quality insufficient at Haiku -> escalate to Sonnet (cost-gated, Sonnet-daily needs approval).
dissent_or_alternative: None (security + data + product consistent).

decision: JSON everywhere at V1 (Lambda + jq over a few MB). Athena earns its place ONLY when ALL three hold: (1) routine cross-day analytical questions (mature layer being built), (2) >=~20 companies / >=2 providers / >=60 days events history, (3) a query a single Lambda can't answer cheaply. Then manual CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE + partition projection (projection.enabled=true), NO Glue crawler (paid, banned), NO Glue job. Parquet conversion runs in a separate worker, never a fat Lambda.
default: JSON V1; Athena only at all-3-conditions
decision_trigger: All three conditions hold -> stand up Athena. Until then, not created.
dissent_or_alternative: Athena from V1 (rejected: pure ceremony + per-query cost at a-few-MB scale).

decision: SSE-S3 (Amazon-managed keys, free) default on the single bucket, S3 Bucket Key on. No SSE-KMS in V1.
decision_trigger: A compliance/audit need for per-key grants earns SSE-KMS despite ~$1/key/mo + KMS request cost (reserve for a later analytics phase only).
dissent_or_alternative: SSE-KMS (rejected for V1: real monthly cost the personal threat model doesn't need).

decision: Explicit finite retention (30 days) set on EVERY CloudWatch log group. Default is Never Expire -> unbounded cost; this is the real Expansion cost lever.
decision_trigger: Longer forensic need or a debug window -> raise deliberately; cost creep -> lower / drop log level.
dissent_or_alternative: Never-expire default (rejected: silent cost accumulation).

decision: AWS Budgets $5 monthly budget, alerts at 50/80/100% + forecast; $10 hard-ceiling alert action. Starter modeled <$5/mo (Haiku/no-Bedrock: V1 ~$0-0.05, Useful ~$0.10-0.30, Expansion ~$1.00-2.50). Sonnet-daily at Expansion (~+$3.15) would threaten $5 -> approval-gated.
decision_trigger: Modeled cost approaches $5 (Expansion with Sonnet-daily / unpartitioned Athena / unbounded logs) -> gate the driver. Budgets is the backstop.
dissent_or_alternative: None (banned always-on infra keeps it bounded).

decision: NO IaC in starter. Manual console build P0-P8 IS the recall telos. SAM/CDK introduced at P9 ONLY after Brett has manually created, wired, observed, broken, and explained every core resource; CI (unit tests + sam validate / cdk synth) at P9 too. IaC must never move earlier.
default: Manual console P0-P8; SAM/CDK at P9
decision_trigger: V1 has run reliably by hand long enough that Brett has broken each resource -> begin P9 reconstruction. Never before.
dissent_or_alternative: Deploy-via-IaC from the start (rejected: inverts the recall telos, automates away the console work whose purpose is recall).

decision: Postings are public but may name recruiters/hiring managers. Redact contact PII from any PUBLIC repo/report/portfolio artifact; store PII only in private S3. Never expose AWS account IDs, full ARNs, credentials, or private financial urgency. No contact harvesting.
default: PII-redacted public artifacts; account identifiers never exposed
decision_trigger: Any public artifact (portfolio, blog, demo) -> run redaction pass first; a real secret ever appears -> Secrets Manager, never code/log.
dissent_or_alternative: None.

decision: Bedrock runs in a SEPARATE feature-flagged llm-role Lambda (jprs-llm), OFF in starter. llm-role may only bedrock:InvokeModel on exactly the two model ARNs (Haiku, 3.5 Sonnet) and has NO write to raw/normalized/events/current — so even a fully successful prompt injection cannot alter stored facts.
decision_trigger: Enable at P8 once the deterministic report is trusted; Sonnet escalation is cost-gated.
dissent_or_alternative: Scoped bedrock statement inside reporter-role (rejected: larger blast radius; security seat prefers separation).

decision: Root prohibited for normal work (MFA on root, no root keys). Human identity = IAM Identity Center short-lived creds + enforced MFA; fallback one MFA'd IAM user, keys rotated <=90d. A shared permissions boundary is attached to EVERY execution role, capping to project resources and denying iam:*, ec2:*, s3:PutBucketPublicAccessBlock, and any make-public action. AI drafts policies; Brett attaches.
default: Identity Center + MFA; permissions boundary on every exec role
decision_trigger: Identity Center setup friction blocks learning -> fallback MFA'd IAM user; new component needs an action outside the cap -> amend boundary explicitly, never widen silently.
dissent_or_alternative: Long-lived broad IAM (forbidden).

decision: SSM Parameter Store Standard tier (free) for all non-secret config (board tokens, company slugs, User-Agent — all public). No Secrets Manager in V1 (all three ATS GET APIs are unauthenticated; Bedrock uses IAM).
decision_trigger: First real secret (a private API key) appears -> that one value goes to Secrets Manager, never code/env-in-repo.
dissent_or_alternative: Secrets Manager for all config (rejected: ~$0.40/secret/mo for public data).

decision: Versioning NEVER enabled (operator hard rule). Raw immutability by write-once unique key (raw/.../snapshot=<ulid>.json.gz); no execution role granted s3:DeleteObject on raw/; retention by lifecycle expiry only. Bucket policy denies aws:SecureTransport=false; Block Public Access ON at account AND bucket (all 4 flags), ACLs disabled (bucket-owner-enforced).
default: versioning OFF; write-once keys; lifecycle; BPA on
decision_trigger: Never enable versioning. Storage cost creeps -> tune lifecycle.
dissent_or_alternative: S3 versioning for immutability (forbidden by operator hard rule).

decision: Collector writes raw/ + normalized/ + receipt (raw/...receipt=) + current/_source_status.json (its own snapshot status). Differ reads normalized/ + current/, writes events/ + advances current/current_jobs.json. Report reads events/ + receipts, writes reports/. One-directional flow preserved; LLM writes no factual tier. (Reconciles architecture+data+reliability consensus that the collector normalizes.)
decision_trigger: Normalize logic grows heavy or needs separate IAM blast-radius / different runtime -> split normalize into a dedicated processor Lambda (security seat's tighter collector->raw-only boundary).
dissent_or_alternative: Security seat's 3-role split collector(raw-only)/processor/reporter (alternative, cleaner least-privilege; deferred).

decision: Collector Lambda timeout 30s (thin fetch+PutObject). Queue visibility timeout >=6x fn timeout (180s for 30s fn) [UNVERIFIED 6x rule — confirm against Lambda ESM best-practices at build]. maxReceiveCount 3 prod / 2 lab. ReportBatchItemFailures ON (itemIdentifier=messageId). Reserved concurrency 2-5 (protect ATS + cost). Batch size 5-10.
default: VT>=6x; maxReceive 3 (2 lab); ReportBatchItemFailures ON; reserved conc 2-5
decision_trigger: Fn timeout changes -> recompute 6x; ATS pagination pushes p99 near ceiling -> raise timeout or split fetch/persist; company count grows -> raise reserved concurrency deliberately.
dissent_or_alternative: None (arch + reliability consistent; 6x is the one UNVERIFIED number to confirm).

decision: Lifecycle, not versioning: raw/ 400d (-> IA/Glacier optional, the only irreplaceable tier — back up before teardown); normalized/ ~90d (regenerable from raw); events/ + reports/ keep long (cheap, the product's memory) or 90d for reports if regenerated; CollectQueue msgs 4d; CollectDLQ msgs 14d (> source); CloudWatch logs 30d; abort-incomplete-MPU 7d.
decision_trigger: Analytics needs deeper history -> extend raw before first expiry; storage cost creeps -> tighten.
dissent_or_alternative: None.
